WITH picked AS ( SELECT id FROM sys_message_outbox WHERE ( status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ) OR ( status = 'SENDING' AND updated_at <= #{staleSendingBefore} ) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), claimed AS ( UPDATE sys_message_outbox o SET status = 'SENDING', updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 FROM picked WHERE o.id = picked.id RETURNING o.* ) SELECT
FROM claimed ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, id ASC
